title: Recording, mixing: Sisters, O Sisters by John Lennon and Yoko Ono | 1972
content:
Record Plant, New York City
Producers: John Lennon, Yoko Ono, Phil Spector

John Lennon and Yoko Ono recorded the Some Time In New York City song ‘Sisters, O Sisters’ on 28 February 1972.

The song was mostly completed during this session, and was mixed too, but it was remixed after the string overdub took place on 18 March.

Page last updated: 12 March 2026
